column3: “Call out against it” is rendered “proclaim to it.”
“A great city to God” is rendered “an exceedingly great city,” and “a journey” “walk.”
“Had a proclamation made” is rendered “issued a proclamation,” and “great people” “nobles”; “graze” is rendered “eat.”
“With strength” is rendered “earnestly”; NASB renders the jussives with “must” and “that each may turn.”
“Turn back from the burning of his anger” is rendered “withdraw His burning anger.”
“The evil” is rendered “the calamity,” and “said” “declared”; NASB supplies “bring.”
